note.text: Two line items on a single claims-sharing package: D7210 (surgical extraction) and D6010 (immediate endosteal implant), both tooth #30, both performed 2026-07-15. This is the commercial-payer direction of the ODEDentalClaim profile, billing the Commercial Dental PPO's dental benefit directly — the counterpart to UC02a's Medicaid-dental direction and UC01's medical-payer direction, demonstrating one profile shape generalizes across all three.

NO prior authorization reference anywhere on this claim — none exists for this episode. UC02b's commercial coverage returned a negative CRD result (no PA required), so unlike UC02a (whose claims-sharing package carries PA number TX-MCD-PA-2026-047291 forward via supportingInfo), the only supportingInfo entry here is the referring provider's referral. CDT alone (D7210, D6010) is what's required; no CPT crosswalk reasoning applies (dental payer, not medical), and no KX or other medical-necessity modifier.

Deliberately excluded, per this profile's own non-financial design: unitPrice, net, total, adjudication. Also deliberately out of scope per this interaction's own narrative: the future implant crown claim (D6065/D6066) at the general dental practice — it happens ~4 months later after osseointegration and is a separate billing event not modeled here, even though the Device record was transmitted at I4 to enable it. The narrative flags 'restorative continuity' as a value proposition but explicitly does not resolve the future crown claim here; that open question is noted rather than built.
